title: Run a short pedagogy pilot with the student before building more lessons
description: Per the outside review and curriculum design: a one to two week pilot (paper CPU, lesson 1.1 on the explorer, a multiply loop, and a C-first contrast session in Compiler Explorer). Measure bonuses attempted unprompted, prediction accuracy, explain-back, want-another-one. Decide machine-code-first vs C-first from the evidence.
right_now_summary: The team is preparing a one- to two-week student pilot to test lesson order and learning outcomes.
